Coralina Kamala

Condominium in Kamala
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleCoralina Kamala

Project overview

"The Hidden Gem": eight seven-storey residential buildings plus a facilities building on about 18,100 sqm in Kamala, with modern-soft architecture and a tropical garden.

564 units plus 5 shops. Kamala Beach is about 300 m away.

Coralina Kamala: key facts

  • Coralina Kamala is a condominium in Kamala, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 26–128 sqm.
  • Construction status: pre-sale; completion listed as Nov 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,990,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Kamala Beach (300 m); Wattanapat Hospital (450 m); Phuket FantaSea (500 m); Big C (1 km).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: The Nayabella Condominium, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Casa De Monte, The Title Fizz.
